binding_rule: These settings are binding for v2.1 and are recovered from the approved OSF registration ahxn9 plus pre-analysis reproducibility clarifications that do not contradict it.

directional_hypotheses.H4: The state-dominant six-construct subset retains a positive but smaller increment than the full eight-score set. A substantially smaller increment would indicate that much of the signal reflects documented management intent rather than patient state.
directional_hypotheses.H5: TF-IDF adds at least as much discrimination as the eight semantic scores, and the semantic scores add little once TF-IDF is included. This hypothesis concerns the trade-off between compact interpretable scores and high-dimensional lexical text; it is not a claim that the semantic scores are superior.
directional_hypotheses.H9: External discrimination in Zigong is above chance but lower than internal discrimination.

submitted_form_text_pending_verbatim_imp.exploratory_analysis_list: The following are exploratory and will be reported under a separate heading: semantic increments among stays in the lower 80% of comparator-predicted risk, with alert-rate summaries (events detected, positive predictive value, number evaluated per additional event); subgroup calibration and semantic-score distributions by recorded ethnicity, insurance and language; note-category (author-type) differences; changes in semantic scores across successive pre-landmark notes; comparison of CareVue and MetaVision results as a documentation-system shift. Any other analysis not listed in this registration will also be labelled exploratory.
